title: GradICON
paper_title: GradICON: Approximate Diffeomorphisms via Gradient Inverse Consistency
core_mech: 通过双向预测与复合映射 Jacobian 的 gradient inverse-consistency 正则获得近似微分同胚。
core_mech_en: Enforces diffeomorphic regularity without tuning sensitive multi-scale smoothness weights by penalizing the Frobenius norm of the composed forward–backward Jacobian deviation from identity.
input_desc: 图像 A 与图像 B
input_en: Ordered pairs (I^A, I^B) and (I^B, I^A) fed symmetrically to a registration network
output_desc: 近似互逆、规则的双向配准映射 Phi_AB 与 Phi_BA
output_en: Approximately diffeomorphic, inverse-consistent forward map Φ^AB and backward map Φ^BA

adapter.name: GradICON
adapter.mechanism: Bidirectional warps are composed and the spatial derivative of composition error is penalized.
limitations: Finite-difference Jacobians and a small shared network; no original multistep registration architecture or topology guarantee.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
